item.title: Australia's ASIC says it is not convinced retail prediction markets are in the public interest and likens the contracts to bets, The Straight reports
item.description: - **Australia's ASIC says it is not convinced retail prediction markets are in the public interest and likens the contracts to bets, The Straight reports** — ASIC Chair Sarah Court said prediction market contracts are highly speculative all-or-nothing products sharing features with binary options, which are banned for Australian retail clients until 2031. No operator is licensed in Australia or has applied for a licence, and Australians using offshore platforms have no protection under Australian law. (The Straight)
